Currently triggers a 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' warning (cosmetic, no functional impact). critical_code_review_comments: routers/colleges.py: solid design — single name_lower index, case-insensitive duplicate check, bulk upload snapshots existing names once (no N+1), supports ',' and ';' delimiters in courses cell, blank-name rows are reported in skipped_blank_rows. Good UX.

Public endpoint correctly mounted via separate public_router (no auth dep). Office Admin can read /api/colleges (drives dropdown) — write ops are super_admin-gated through _require_super_admin(). Matches the requested permission model.

Colleges.jsx (super_admin write UI) and CollegeSelect.jsx (reusable combobox) both have comprehensive data-testid coverage and amber/orange theming matches Tailwind 'btn-amber' / amber-700 conventions used elsewhere.

PublicApplication.jsx line 275: courseOptions correctly falls back to the static courses list when the chosen college has no courses defined — sensible UX. The 'reset interested_course if not in new college's catalog' on college change (lines 287-291) prevents stale invalid submissions.
Minor: CollegeSelect key={c.id} should defensively support `c.id || c.name` since the public endpoint currently returns no id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Colleges feature is functionally complete and stable. The only outstanding nit is the missing 'id' in /api/public/colleges projection — fix is a one-line backend change. CollegeSelect is reused on 3 screens (Students new-admission, StudentDetail header edit, PublicApplication step 2) and works in both authenticated (uses /api/colleges) and public (uses preset list from /api/public/colleges) modes. The Interested Course narrowing on /apply only fires when the selected college has courses on file; otherwise it falls back to the static course list (intentional).
rca of the issue: React 'unique key' warning on /apply: /api/public/colleges projection excludes id → CollegeSelect maps colleges to <button key={c.id}> where c.id is undefined → React fires warning for each option. Reproduction: open /apply in incognito, advance to Step 2, click Preferred College dropdown → console emits warning. Mitigation: include id in the public projection OR use `key={c.id || c.name}` in CollegeSelect.
